property_summary: For any depositor, withdrawAll always succeeds (does not revert) and sends the depositor their credited Ether (so calling withdrawAll returns normally); the mutant that inverts the require(callResult) will revert when the external transfer succeeds, so there exist inputs (a depositor with a positive balance and a callee that accepts the payment) that cause withdrawAll to revert.
change_summary: Replace the require(callResult) with require(!callResult) so the call path reverts on success instead of failure.
